name: Jukubo Nakadashi Mendan ~Oshiego no Haha Kan'in no Susume~
original_name: 熟母中出し面談～教え子の母・姦淫のススメ～
source:
Nozomu is a teacher. One day, Kazuha comes to him and tells about her son who refuses to go to school. "First of all, you should enjoy your life!" Like this, he has sex with her.... Her demeanor gradually gets bolder day by day, and finally...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090110055224/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008775]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
望是一名教师。一天，橘和叶来找他，谈起自己拒绝上学的儿子。

“首先，你自己应该好好享受人生！”

就这样，望与她发生了关系……她的举止一天比一天大胆，最终……
